verdict.rationale: Greptile's docs describe a learning system that trains on 👍/👎 reactions and reply explanations. After 2-3 weeks it stops commenting on things the team doesn't care about. It also auto-indexes existing rule files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, cursor.rules), supports custom rules and style guides scoped to team directories, and lets users view, search, and create coding patterns via MCP, together forming a persistent memory of conventions applied to future reviews. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the learned memory actually improves later reviews, and detail on how specific past review decisions are stored and recalled beyond reaction-based noise suppression.
